Signs Your Fascias or Gutters Need Replacing

  • Gutters that overflow in heavy rain or drip at the joints
  • Timber fascia boards that are rotten, flaking or split
  • Soffit boards that are sagging or have holes birds can get into
  • Damp patches on the outside walls under the gutter
  • Gutters that have pulled away from the fascia

Useful to Tell Us About Fascias and Gutters

  • Whether the boards are wood or uPVC now
  • The colour you would like (white, black, grey or another)
  • Whether it is the whole house or just one side or the extension
